name: MIMO Wireless Communication
description:
Introduction to diversity in space, time, and frequency; Fading channel models; SIMO, MISO, and MIMO channels; MIMO information theory; Receive diversity and diversity combining techniques: Maximal-ratio combining (MRC), equal-gain combining (EGC), selection combining (SC),
hybrid selection/maximal-ratio combining (H-S/MRC), generalized selection combining (GSC), postdetection EGC; Error performance evaluation; Transmit diversity and space-time block codes (STBCs); Linear STBC design; Differential coding for MIMO, precoding, multiuser MIMO; Fully and partially noncoherent multi-antenna systems.
